# jj orbit (vendored)

The runtime files of jj orbit 0.32.2 (server, exporter, built viewer, browser bundles), copied unchanged from
the jj-orbit snapshot of 2026-10-22. fleet starts `jj_orbit_server.py` on a free loopback port and proxies it under
`/orbit/` for the history view. Update by copying a newer release over these files; do not edit them here.
